name: Forest fires in South Sudan, Central African Republic
summary: Between 2026-10-03 and 2026-10-15, HH backscatter here changed by -0.6 dB and HV by -0.4 dB (mean within 500 m). Across the mapped area, 0% got at least 3 dB weaker and 0% at least 3 dB stronger.
method: NISAR L2 GCOV (terrain-corrected gamma-naught), frequency A, 2 passes on track 043-A-006-DHDH. Time series: mean linear power within 500 m of the point, in dB. Change map: HH after minus before, 5×5 mean filter against speckle, changes under 1.5 dB not drawn; 'after' is the pass that differs most from the first in HH (this track does not have a pass on both sides of the event of 2026-11-16 yet).
